Application Data.NAME: Quality Coatings Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Quality Coatings Inc. is a retail store specializing in high-quality paints, wallpapers, and related home improvement products. We offer a wide selection of interior and exterior paints, primers, and finishes, as well as an extensive range of wallpapers and decorative wall coverings. Our knowledgeable staff provides expert advice and personalized color consultations to assist customers in selecting the right products for their projects. Additionally, we carry painting tools, brushes, and accessories to ensure a complete shopping experience for DIY enthusiasts and professional contractors alike. We strive to create a welcoming environment for all customers while maintaining safety and compliance standards in our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a customer accidentally spilled paint while shopping, causing damage to store property estimated at $1,500. The claim was closed on 04/10/2023 after payment was made. On 07/22/2023, a small fire occurred in the storage area due to an electrical fault, resulting in damages of $1,000. The fire was quickly contained, and the claim remains open for investigation.
